notes.Luka Doncic: He had 32 points, eight rebounds and 10 assists in 39 minutes Monday at Atlanta and has topped 65 DraftKings points in each of his last three games. Milwaukee is 1-10, on the second night of a back-to-back and lost by 32 at New York on Tuesday, so the 12.5-point spread is the only worry.
notes.Nikola Jokic: He had 25 points, 16 rebounds and nine assists in 39 minutes Monday. Memphis is without Scotty Pippen Jr. and Quinten Post, and Isaiah Stewart is questionable, which leaves the Grizzlies thin up front in a 230.5-point game.
notes.Victor Wembanyama: He scored 40 points with 11 rebounds in only 25 minutes Monday at Phoenix and has played 24 to 26 minutes in each of his last three games. Tobias Harris is out and Devin Vassell is questionable, but San Antonio is a 15.5-point favorite, so a blowout could cap his minutes again.
notes.Jayson Tatum: He had 21 points in 32 minutes Tuesday at Philadelphia, and tonight is the second night of a back-to-back. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard and Scottie Barnes. Boston's injury report is not posted yet.
notes.Anthony Davis: He had 44 points and 13 rebounds in 34 minutes Monday. Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton, and the game is lined as close (2.5 points).
notes.Cameron Johnson: He has started and played 29 to 31 minutes in each of his last three games. He scored only eight points Monday, so his value comes from the minutes in a 230.5-point game.
notes.Jordan Poole: He played 34 minutes off the bench Monday at Golden State when Trey Murphy III sat. Murphy is probable tonight, which likely trims Poole's minutes, but Yves Missi and Trendon Watford are both out.
notes.Danny Wolf: He started Brooklyn's last two games and played 31 and 36 minutes. Egor Demin is probable to return after missing six games and Nolan Traore is questionable, so the lineup around him may shift.
notes.Alijah Martin: Kawhi Leonard and Scottie Barnes are out, and Immanuel Quickley and Collin Murray-Boyles are questionable. Martin scored 27 points in 31 minutes on Nov. 6 but only two points in 21 minutes Monday, so his role swings with who plays.
notes.Jerami Grant: He has played 22 to 24 minutes off the bench in his last three games and scored 17 points Monday. Scotty Pippen Jr. and Quinten Post are out and Isaiah Stewart is questionable with a right knee bone bruise.
notes.Javon Small: He has played 20 to 24 minutes in his last three games with five assists Monday. Scotty Pippen Jr. is out again with a lumbar disc herniation, which keeps backup point guard minutes open.
notes.Quenton Jackson: Tyrese Haliburton is out, and T.J. McConnell is questionable with a right hamstring strain. Jackson played 25 minutes Monday with 10 points, five rebounds and four assists.
notes.Collin Sexton: He scored 17 and 18 points in his last two games and played 27 minutes Monday. Quentin Grimes is questionable with a right finger sprain, which would open more guard minutes, but the 12.5-point spread brings blowout risk.
notes.Paul George: He scored 36 points with six 3-pointers in 30 minutes Tuesday at Philadelphia. Boston has rested him on the second night of back-to-backs, and tonight is one; Boston's injury report is not posted yet.
notes.Payton Pritchard: He played 30 minutes off the bench Tuesday and had 18 points, six rebounds and five assists. Boston is on the second night of a back-to-back, so he matters most if Paul George or another starter rests. Its injury report is not posted yet.
notes.Jalen Brunson: He played only 28 minutes Tuesday, when no New York starter topped 28 in a 32-point win over Milwaukee. Tonight is the second night of a back-to-back, and New York's injury report is not posted yet.
notes.Karl-Anthony Towns: He had 21 points and 16 rebounds in 27 minutes Tuesday. Tonight is the second night of a back-to-back, and New York's injury report is not posted yet.
notes.Josh Hart: He missed Tuesday with an illness, his third straight absence, though coach Mike Brown said the ankle had healed enough to play. New York's injury report is not posted yet.
notes.Tyler Kolek: He scored 12 points with four assists in 15 minutes as Jalen Brunson's backup Tuesday. New York is on the second night of a back-to-back, which can mean more bench minutes.
notes.Egor Demin: He is probable after missing six straight games with a right leg bone bruise, and he practiced Tuesday. Nolan Traore is questionable, so Demin could step back into a big role.
notes.Nolan Traore: He is questionable with right calf soreness. He has started seven of Brooklyn's 10 games, and Egor Demin is probable to return.
notes.Trey Murphy III: He is probable after sitting Monday on the second night of a back-to-back to manage his knees. Yves Missi and Trendon Watford are out.
notes.Cameron Boozer: He had 22 points, seven rebounds and eight assists in 33 minutes Monday, and he has played a lot of center with Isaiah Stewart out. Stewart is questionable tonight.
notes.Isaiah Stewart: He is questionable with a right knee bone bruise after missing the last two games.
notes.Stephen Curry: Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody, Gary Payton II and Brandon Williams are all out, and Will Richard is questionable. Curry scored 41 points in 36 minutes on Nov. 7.
notes.Alperen Sengun: Clint Capela and Steven Adams are both out, so Houston has little size behind him. He had 20 points, 12 rebounds and eight assists in 35 minutes Monday.
notes.Kevin Durant: He has played 35 to 38 minutes in each of his last three games, with 23 points, 12 rebounds and eight assists Monday.
notes.Josh Giddey: He had 19 points, seven rebounds and 15 assists in 34 minutes Sunday. Norman Powell is questionable with low back spasms.
notes.Isaac Okoro: He started Sunday when Norman Powell sat, and Powell is questionable again with low back spasms.
notes.Andrew Nembhard: Tyrese Haliburton is out, and he had 12 points and 12 assists in 34 minutes Monday. T.J. McConnell is questionable.
notes.Immanuel Quickley: He is questionable after missing the last two games with right hamstring tightness. Kawhi Leonard and Scottie Barnes are out.
notes.Collin Murray-Boyles: He is questionable with an illness after sitting out Monday. Kawhi Leonard and Scottie Barnes are out, so his minutes were rising before he got sick.
notes.Franz Wagner: He scored a season-high 33 points with seven assists in 38 minutes Tuesday, and Paolo Banchero has missed eight straight games. Tonight is the second night of a back-to-back, and Orlando's injury report is not posted yet. This game is off the main slate.
notes.Anthony Black: He had 26 points and four steals in 33 minutes Tuesday with Jalen Suggs out. Orlando is on a back-to-back and has not posted its injury report. This game is off the main slate.
notes.Darryn Peterson: He scored 25 points Tuesday, his second straight game near his career high, with Keyonte George out. Utah is on a back-to-back and has not posted its injury report. This game is off the main slate.
notes.Isaiah Collier: He made four 3-pointers in the fourth quarter Tuesday and finished with 17 points in 24 minutes off the bench. Utah's injury report is not posted yet. This game is off the main slate.
notes.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: He scored 26 points in 29 minutes Tuesday at Portland and sat the whole fourth quarter of a 20-point loss. Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren and Cason Wallace are out, and the teams meet again tonight; Oklahoma City has not posted its report. This game is on the late slate.
notes.Jared McCain: He started Tuesday and scored 21 points in 31 minutes with Oklahoma City missing several guards. The Thunder have not posted tonight's report. This game is on the late slate.
notes.Sidy Cissoko: He started in place of Scoot Henderson Tuesday and scored 17 points in 33 minutes. Portland has not posted its injury report. This game is on the late slate.
notes.Deni Avdija: He had 24 points, eight assists and six rebounds in 34 minutes Tuesday against the same Oklahoma City team. Portland has not posted its injury report. This game is on the late slate.
notes.Damian Lillard: He scored 25 points in 24 minutes Tuesday against Oklahoma City. Portland has not posted its injury report. This game is on the late slate.
